studionet.notes: v10.1 — reviewer-fix release on top of v10 Secondary Market. (1) list_for_resale / transfer_license / buy_from_resale now re-check the seller license is still ACTIVE and the tier still transferable at list, transfer AND purchase time, before moving any rights or funds. (2) Default-tier (tier_0) deactivation now blocks BOTH purchase_license (legacy) and purchase_license_tier — no silent fallback sale. (3) Cross-tier renewal is defined + enforced: same-tier renews/stacks, a still-active license on a different tier REVERTS (no silent re-labelling of bought time), expired licenses may switch tier as a fresh buy. (4) A takedown notice issued before a later appeal now reflects an overturn (takedown_revoked + is_takedown_revoked view; get_takedown_notice surfaces revoked=true). +16 contract tests. See CHANGELOG.md 2026-10-04 section.
